# SBA Doubles the Veteran-Owned Contracting Goal to 10%: How SDVOSBs and Primes Should Reshape FY27 Pipelines


The SBA just doubled the FY27 veteran-owned contracting goal from 5% to 10%, and agencies are already being scored against it. Here's an 8-step playbook for SDVOSBs and primes to reshape FY27 pipelines, vet teaming partners, and re-baseline subcontracting plans before the next RFP drops.
